If that carries into the ensemble, a 16-member ensemble of snapshot-averaged members should beat the incumbent 16-member ensemble of single-best-checkpoint members.

important_caveat_stated_in_advance: Full validation UNDERSTATES this change by construction. The incumbent's epoch was chosen by argmax on this same validation set, so the control is optimistically fitted to the set it is scored on. E5's held-out measurement is the less biased estimate of how the two rules compare on unseen data, i.e. on the hidden test.
